summary: A parent, Anna, who recently moved to Finland from England, is seeking full-time daycare options for their three-year-old daughter, Vivian, who speaks English at home. The conversation discusses different daycare types in Espo, including municipal and private family day care, which typically have smaller groups, and daycare centers similar to England’s nursery system. The advisor mentions there are 170 daycare centers in Espo, with 90 private options, some offering Finnish and some Swedish. The parent is interested in English-speaking daycare options in Espo. The advisor acknowledges the need for English-speaking services and offers to provide more information.

questionnaire.Contents of the customer visit: Family life (eg.: children's school, early childhood education, relationships)
